findings.reason: The finite-sum nonnegativity lambda explicitly binds l : Fin (n+1) and Nat.cast_nonneg (l.val+1). It now proves nonnegativity for the actual variable summand C l * (l.val+1), rather than allowing the chosen j+1 to be inferred for every summand. The chosen j-prime has val j definitionally, so single_le_sum and the unchanged addition of one yield the actual A.

Fin.sum_univ_succ exposes head and successor entries of order = Fin.cons (s+e c.length+delta) (fun _ => BK+delta). Explicit Fin.cons_zero/succ reduce exactly these entries; constant sum and omega then prove the unchanged total-order budget.
The same two cons rewrites reduce the assigned-order product from hpD to the unchanged P high-order factor times P(BK+delta)^c.length. No factor, direction, or order is changed.

After sum_mul and Fin.sum_univ_succ, the two cons rewrites identify the actual input head with x and successor slots with w. The exact K0 affine one-high right-hand side is retained; there is no replacement of the genuine jet input.
